## Notes

Reviewed: #497 says `review-skipped`; #249 has no `Reviewed by:` [V gh pr view].

Shipped: `Deploy health` success on d5ebc93 (#497) and aba449d (#249). Criteria 1, 4 and 5 are not (fully) built, so Shipped is `no` for them by the rule.

Smoked: `smoke-live` runs on a schedule against main and opens only the routes whose files merged in the last 26 hours, as builder accounts; it checks that the page loads, throws nothing and shows no stray email address. Green runs: 2026-10-19 (cd913c7: page, you-following and more), 10-23 (cb892a7: page, page-private, explore, you, page-business, page-edit) [V gh run view]. Criteria 2 and 3 are smoked by that rule: every public surface and the following list opened green; the smoke looks for stray emails, not names. `/onboarding` is skipped there; the operator report page shows no legal name yet.

Changed since 2026-10-16: criterion 2 was `unknown` and is now built: the surfaces where a peer sees a member's name are the Page's "Started by" line (reads `page_founder_public`, which returns the display name only) and the following list, and the legal name is rendered nowhere; posts are by Pages, responses do not exist, the profile is retired. One check ticket filed for it. Criterion 1 got worse: since #946 (2026-10-18) the one way in is email then a 6-digit code, which lands on the page the person came from and never on `/onboarding`, so a new member can use the app with no legal name; #847 is the fix and now gates F081.1 too (labelled `launch-blocking` today).
